item.title: Apple 智能备案新增 iPad 和笔记本
item.guid: Apple-智能备案新增-iPad-和笔记本
item.description:
Wangxin Shanghai announced on November 9 that Apple's intelligent generative AI services have added two new applicable scenarios: Apple tablets and laptops, and have completed the filing. The revised scope of application includes Apple phones, tablets, and laptops. 网信上海 11 月 9 日发布公告，Apple 智能生成式人工智能服务新增苹果平板和笔记本电脑两类适用场景，已完成备案。变更后的适用范围包括苹果手机、平板和笔记本电脑。

The filing entity listed in the announcement is Apple Technology Development (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., with the original filing date being July 8, and the scenario change date being November 9. 公告所列备案主体为苹果技术开发（上海）有限公司，原备案日期为 7 月 8 日，此次场景变更日期为 11 月 9 日。

item.title: 英伟达逆势大跌 4.27%，一夜蒸发 1.29 万亿元
item.guid: 英伟达逆势大跌-4.27%，一夜蒸发-1.29-万亿元
item.description:
On November 9, Eastern Time, Nvidia's stock price closed down 4.27% at $178.67, with its market value shrinking by approximately $192.1 billion in a single day, equivalent to about 1.29 trillion yuan. Currently, Nvidia's total market value is approximately $4.31 trillion. 美东时间 11 月 9 日，英伟达股价收跌 4.27%，报 178.67 美元，单日市值缩水约 1921 亿美元，折合人民币约 1.29 万亿元。目前，英伟达总市值约为 4.31 万亿美元。

On the same day, the three major U.S. stock indexes collectively rose, with the Nasdaq Composite Index gaining 2.74%, while Nvidia fell against the trend. During intraday trading, its stock price once dropped to $170.24, a decline of nearly 9% from the previous trading day's closing price. 当天美股三大股指集体上涨，其中纳斯达克综合指数涨幅达 2.74%，英伟达却逆势下跌。盘中其股价一度跌至 170.24 美元，较前一交易日收盘价跌幅接近 9%。

This stock price decline comes as Nvidia's management faces an investigation. According to Reuters, Nvidia's board of directors announced on November 8 the launch of an independent investigation to verify whether CEO Jensen Huang had been a target of foreign intelligence activities. The investigation is being conducted by an independent board committee and external legal counsel. 此次股价下跌正值英伟达管理层面临调查。据路透社报道，英伟达董事会于 11 月 8 日宣布启动独立调查，以核实 CEO 黄仁勋是否曾成为外国情报活动的目标。调查由独立董事委员会及外部法律顾问负责。

Nvidia emphasized in an official statement that there is currently no reason to believe that U.S. national security or the company's trade secrets have been compromised. The board of directors remains confident in Jensen Huang and his management team, and Huang himself has pledged to cooperate with the investigation. 英伟达在官方声明中强调，目前没有理由认为美国国家安全或公司商业机密受到损害。董事会仍对黄仁勋及其管理团队保持信心，黄仁勋本人也承诺配合调查。

Reuters pointed out that the investigation could exacerbate investors' concerns about the stability of Nvidia's management. At the same time, market doubts about the sustainability of AI infrastructure investment continue to affect the performance of technology stocks. 路透社指出，调查可能加剧投资者对英伟达管理层稳定性的担忧。与此同时，市场对 AI 基础设施投资可持续性的疑虑也持续影响科技股表现。

Previously, Nvidia's stock price had plunged 9.26% on November 5. Although it rebounded 2.78% the next day, the latest round of declines has put its stock price under renewed pressure. 此前，英伟达股价已于 11 月 5 日大跌 9.26%，虽然次日反弹 2.78%，但最新一轮下跌使其股价再度承压。

item.title: 曝苹果调整 iOS 28 开发节奏，首阶段留出六周探索功能
item.guid: 曝苹果调整-iOS-28-开发节奏，首阶段留出六周探索功能
item.description:
According to Mark Gurman of Bloomberg, Apple has adjusted the development process for its next-generation operating system, iOS 28. The first development phase (M1) allocates six weeks for coding, exploration, and feature development, followed by only two weeks for integration. 据彭博社 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果已调整下一代操作系统 iOS 28 的开发流程，首个开发阶段（M1）留出六周用于编码、探索和功能开发，随后仅有两周用于整合。

The report states that Apple is currently deeply advancing the development of next year's new systems, with iOS 28 and iPadOS 28 codenamed Bell, and macOS 28 codenamed Poppy. 报道称，苹果目前已深入推进明年的新系统开发，其中 iOS 28 和 iPadOS 28 代号为 Bell，macOS 28 代号为 Poppy。

Conventionally, Apple's annual new system development is divided into three main phases: M1, M2, and M3. Each phase lasts eight weeks, comprising four weeks of coding and four weeks of integration, where integration refers to incorporating various features into the operating system. 按照惯例，苹果每年的新系统开发分为 M1、M2、M3 三个主要阶段，每个阶段持续八周，包含四周编码和四周整合，整合指的是将各项功能集成进操作系统。

In this M1 phase, Apple did not follow the usual two four-week arrangement. Instead, engineers spent six weeks on coding, exploration, and feature development, followed by two weeks for integration. The report mentioned that some employees expressed liking this change, believing it allows more time for conceptualization and experimentation before features are locked down. 此次 M1 阶段，苹果没有沿用两个四周的常规安排，而是让工程师先用六周进行编码、探索和功能开发，再用两周完成整合。报道提到，有员工表示喜欢这一变化，认为这样能在功能锁定前留出更多时间构思和尝试。

The report also mentioned that Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, is not satisfied with the company's AI progress and has held closed-door meetings with software head Craig Federighi in recent weeks, hoping to accelerate the AI roadmap. 报道同时提到，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 对公司 AI 进展并不满意，近几周已与软件负责人 Craig Federighi 举行闭门会议，希望其加快 AI 路线图。

item.title: 曝玛莎拉蒂拟与尊界合作，新车将由江淮生产
item.guid: 曝玛莎拉蒂拟与尊界合作，新车将由江淮生产
item.description:
According to a November 9 report by Yicai, Maserati's parent company Stellantis is advancing a new car project named 'Maserati Design' with Huawei and JAC. The report states that the new car's exterior has been finalized, with further mass production progress planned for the fourth quarter of 2027. 据第一财经 11 月 9 日报道，玛莎拉蒂母公司 Stellantis 正与华为、江淮推进一项名为「玛莎拉蒂 Design」的新车项目。报道称，新车外观已经确定，计划在 2027 年第四季度迎来进一步的量产进展。

Sources say the project will be manufactured by JAC, with Huawei providing support. The new car is planned to be sold domestically under the Zunjie brand and will continue to use the Maserati emblem overseas. 知情人士称，项目将由江淮负责制造，华为参与提供支持。新车计划在国内由尊界销售，在海外沿用玛莎拉蒂标识。

item.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 和 Mythos 5.2，两款模型 API 降价
item.guid: Anthropic-发布-Claude-Fable-和-Mythos-5.2，两款模型-API-降价
item.description:
Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2. Both products share the same underlying model, with their scope of access differentiated by security settings: Fable will block penetration testing, exploit code generation, and most biological research requests, while qualified cybersecurity or life science research institutions can apply to use Mythos. Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2。两款产品共用同一个底层模型，开放范围由安全设置区分：Fable 会拦截渗透测试、漏洞利用代码生成及多数生物研究类请求，符合条件的网络安全或生命科学研究机构可申请使用 Mythos。

Anthropic states that the new model generates up to 30% faster than version 5.1. Standard API pricing has been reduced to $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Fable 5.2 is now available on the Claude platform, as well as AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Anthropic 称，新模型生成速度较 5.1 版最高快 30%。标准 API 价格降至每百万输入 token 8 美元、每百万输出 token 40 美元。Fable 5.2 已登陆 Claude 平台及 AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure。

In pre-release testing, Anthropic used the model to rewrite an existing proof of Fermat's Last Theorem into a formally verifiable proof. In the company's FrontierSWE v2 programming evaluation, Fable 5.2 scored 69.9%, compared to Fable 5.1's 56.3%. 在发布前测试中，Anthropic 用模型把费马大定理的既有证明写成了可由程序检查的形式化证明。在公司的 FrontierSWE v2 编程评测中，Fable 5.2 得分为 69.9%，Fable 5.1 为 56.3%。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, Claude Fable 5.2 climbed to world number one, defeating Opus 5.5 overnight 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，Claude Fable 5.2 登顶世界第一，一夜斩杀 Opus 5.5

item.title: 谷歌发布两套第八代 TPU 系统，分别面向长上下文和保密推理
item.guid: 谷歌发布两套第八代-TPU-系统，分别面向长上下文和保密推理
item.description:
Google announced TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx on November 9, expanding the eighth-generation TPU lineup that debuted in April this year. Both systems utilize existing chips, with adjustments made to chip packaging and accompanying hardware. 谷歌 11 月 9 日公布 TPU 8i Max 和 TPU 8tx，扩充今年 4 月亮相的第八代 TPU 阵容。两套系统沿用现有芯片，分别调整了芯片封装和配套硬件。

    TPU 8i Max packages two TPU 8i chips together. Google states that compared to TPU 8i, the new system's computing power, on-chip SRAM, and high-bandwidth memory bandwidth are all doubled, used for processing entire codebases or long-context tasks such as long videos.

    TPU 8tx uses the same chip as TPU 8t, paired with a custom AMD host processor. The hardware isolates sensitive data and model weights during inference, and enterprises can also fine-tune models with private data on the same system.

item.title: 迪士尼与 Adobe 达成多年合作，将为旗下 IP 定制生成模型
item.guid: 迪士尼与-Adobe-达成多年合作，将为旗下-IP-定制生成模型
item.description:
Disney and Adobe announced a multi-year partnership. Adobe will provide Disney with early access to its latest creative and media tools, along with engineering and research resources. The two parties will use Firefly Foundry to develop Disney-specific generative models, incorporating character features, scenes, and visual styles into model training. 迪士尼与 Adobe 宣布达成多年合作。Adobe 将向迪士尼提前开放最新的创作和媒体工具，并提供工程与研究资源。双方将用 Firefly Foundry 开发迪士尼专用的生成模型，把角色特征、场景和视觉风格纳入模型训练。

Disney's Imagineering R&D team has already used these tools in theme park development, for example, converting hand-drawn sketches into complete 2D concept art. The partnership also covers Walt Disney Studios' StudioLAB and ESPN Edge, with the latter exploring the use of AI to organize and leverage sports archives, and experiment with new content presentation methods. 迪士尼的幻想工程研发团队已在主题乐园开发中使用这套工具，例如将手绘草图转成完整的二维概念图。合作还覆盖华特迪士尼影业的 StudioLAB 和 ESPN Edge，后者将探索用 AI 整理和利用体育档案，并尝试新的内容呈现方式。

item.title: 詹姆斯·古恩将卸任 DC 影业联席 CEO，前漫威高管接掌创意
item.guid: 詹姆斯·古恩将卸任-DC-影业联席-CEO，前漫威高管接掌创意
item.description:
Skydance announced that Jeremy Latcham, who previously helped build the Marvel Cinematic Universe, will become President and Chief Creative Officer of DC Studios on December 1, overseeing film, television, and animation businesses. James Gunn and Peter Safran will step down from their management roles to return to creative and production work. Skydance 宣布，曾参与搭建漫威电影宇宙的杰里米·拉查姆将于 12 月 1 日出任 DC 影业总裁兼首席创意官，统筹电影、电视和动画业务。詹姆斯·古恩与彼得·萨夫兰将卸下管理职务，回归创作和制片。

Latcham previously participated in the production of "Iron Man," "The Avengers," and "Guardians of the Galaxy." Gunn's written and directed Superman sequel, "Man of Tomorrow," is currently in post-production and is scheduled for release on July 9, 2027, with Gunn and Safran still serving as co-producers. 拉查姆曾参与制作《钢铁侠》《复仇者联盟》和《银河护卫队》。古恩编剧并执导的超人续集《Man of Tomorrow》目前处于后期制作，计划于 2027 年 7 月 9 日上映，古恩和萨夫兰仍共同担任制片人。

item.title: 💡 瑞银 CEO：AI 股回调前，市场一直按「完美情景」定价
item.guid: 💡-瑞银-CEO：AI-股回调前，市场一直按「完美情景」定价
item.description:
According to Reuters, UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti stated at a UBS conference in Sydney on November 9 that the significant pullback in AI stocks over the past few weeks reflects investors' previously overinflated expectations for the industry. He remains optimistic about the economic benefits brought by AI but believes the market has overestimated the speed at which these benefits will materialize. 据路透社报道，瑞银首席执行官塞尔吉奥·埃尔莫蒂 11 月 9 日在悉尼出席瑞银会议时表示，过去数周 AI 股票的明显回调，反映出投资者此前对行业的预期过高。他仍看好 AI 带来的经济收益，但认为市场高估了这些收益兑现的速度。

Until recently, the market had been pricing in a perfect scenario. Of course, we've seen some pullbacks in the past few weeks.

Ermotti mentioned that the results of the US midterm elections, as well as global debates surrounding the impact of AI infrastructure development, could slow down the industry's progress in achieving results. 埃尔莫蒂提到，美国中期选举结果，以及全球围绕 AI 基础设施建设影响的争论，都可能拖慢行业取得成果的进度。

He also used UBS as an example to illustrate the speed of enterprise implementation. UBS agreed to acquire Credit Suisse in 2023, and Ermotti stated that the subsequent integration work slowed down the implementation of some internal AI applications at UBS. 他也以瑞银为例说明企业落地的速度。瑞银在 2023 年同意收购瑞信，埃尔莫蒂表示，随后的整合工作拖慢了瑞银内部部分 AI 应用的落地。

item.title: 比亚迪第 1900 万辆新能源汽车下线，方程豹钛 9 同日开订
item.guid: 比亚迪第-1900-万辆新能源汽车下线，方程豹钛-9-同日开订
item.description:
On November 9, BYD's 19 millionth new energy vehicle rolled off the production line at its Xi'an factory, with the model being the Fangchengbao Bao 9. On the same day, Fangchengbao opened national pre-orders for the Bao 9 and announced the configuration of its top-spec version. 11 月 9 日，比亚迪第 1900 万辆新能源汽车在西安工厂下线，下线车型为方程豹钛 9。同一天，方程豹开启钛 9 的全国预订，并公布顶配版配置。

The Bao 9 is a large six-seater plug-in hybrid SUV with a square body design, equipped with BYD's DMS hybrid platform and second-generation Blade Battery, and features the DiSus-A intelligent body control system. The top-spec version adds a 1.1-meter panoramic head-up display and a 30-inch cockpit screen. Sina Auto reported that the new car will be officially launched within November. 钛 9 是一款采用方正车身的大六座插混 SUV，搭载比亚迪 DMS 混动平台和第二代刀片电池，配备云辇-A 车身控制系统。顶配版增加了 1.1 米全景抬头显示和 30 英寸座舱屏。新浪汽车报道称，新车将于 11 月内正式上市。

item.title: 千问办公 2.0 发布，团队可共享资料并让 AI 按消息触发任务
item.guid: 千问办公-2.0-发布，团队可共享资料并让-AI-按消息触发任务
item.description:
Qianwen Office released version 2.0 on November 9. Teams can link DingTalk group chats, meeting notes, spreadsheets, and documents in a collaborative space to manage and assign tasks. After members assign tasks via instant messaging, the digital employee "Xiao Q" can organize project progress and set to-dos based on the information in the space. Members can also view, correct, or disable space memory. 千问办公 11 月 9 日发布 2.0 版。团队可以在协作空间里关联钉钉群聊、听记、表格和文档，管理并指派任务。成员通过即时通讯交办后，数字员工「小 Q」可以结合空间里的资料梳理项目进展、设置待办。成员也可以查看、纠正或停用空间记忆。

The new version supports message-triggered automatic tasks, with the first batch of rules including receiving messages from designated contacts and being @-mentioned in specified groups. Pure cloud-based tasks can still run after the computer is shut down, and users can modify, disable rules, and view execution results and failure reasons on the web or desktop client. 新版支持按消息触发自动任务，首批规则包括收到指定联系人发来的消息，以及在指定群里被 @。纯云端任务在电脑关机后仍可运行，用户可以在网页端或桌面端修改、停用规则，并查看执行结果和失败原因。

When modifying AI-generated content, users can select specific paragraphs, cells, slides, or application areas, submit multiple modification suggestions at once, and have the AI directly modify the original output. 修改 AI 生成的内容时，用户可以选中具体的段落、单元格、幻灯片或应用区域，一次提交多处修改意见，由 AI 在原有成果上直接修改。

item.title: 英伟达推出 GR00T 2，让机器人从人类示范中学习精细操作
item.guid: 英伟达推出-GR00T-2，让机器人从人类示范中学习精细操作
item.description:
NVIDIA unveiled GR00T 2, the training framework Isaac Lab 3.0, and two open evaluations for industrial operations at the CoRL robotics learning conference on November 9. The new model is based on NVIDIA Cosmos, capable of learning from human demonstrations and transferring skills to different robot bodies. 英伟达在 11 月 9 日的机器人学习大会 CoRL 上公布 GR00T 2、训练框架 Isaac Lab 3.0，以及两套面向工业操作的开放评测。新模型基于 NVIDIA Cosmos，能从人类示范中学习，也能把技能迁移到不同的机器人本体上。

NVIDIA stated that among the 50 tasks it evaluated, GR00T 2 successfully completed at least one of 40 tasks even without seeing a corresponding task demonstration. After providing one demonstration for each task, the average success rate was 71%, increasing to 95% after five demonstrations. 英伟达称，在其评估的 50 项任务中，GR00T 2 没看过对应任务示范时，有 40 项至少成功完成过一次。每项提供一次示范后，平均成功率为 71%，增加到五次示范后为 95%。

Isaac Lab 3.0 allows AI agents to build training environments and switch between PhysX and Newton physics solvers. DexBench, announced concurrently, covers four types of scenarios: retail, logistics, manufacturing, and hospitality services, while VABAR provides standardized condition changes, difficulty, and success metrics for six industrial tasks. Isaac Lab 3.0 可用 AI 智能体搭建训练环境，并在 PhysX 和 Newton 两套物理求解器之间切换。同期公布的 DexBench 覆盖零售、物流、制造和酒店服务四类场景，VABAR 则为六项工业任务提供标准化的条件变化、难度和成功指标。

item.title: 字节跳动发布 Seedream 5.5，生成图片可直接带透明背景
item.guid: 字节跳动发布-Seedream-5.5，生成图片可直接带透明背景
item.description:
ByteDance's Seed team released the image model Seedream 5.5 on November 9. The new model can directly generate images with an Alpha channel, preserving transparent and translucent parts, and the generated elements can be directly used as independent design assets. 字节跳动 Seed 团队 11 月 9 日发布图像模型 Seedream 5.5。新模型可直接生成带 Alpha 通道的图片，透明和半透明的部分可以保留下来，生成的元素可直接用作独立设计素材。

The team also demonstrated the results of continuously editing the same character image for 100 rounds. Each round used the previous image as a base, modifying clothing, accessories, and desktop objects sequentially. In the later stages, details like rings and spectacle frames could still be adjusted individually. Seed stated that this version underwent specialized training for local editing to reduce color shifts and detail loss in unmodified areas during repeated generation. 团队也展示了同一张人物图连续编辑 100 轮的结果。每轮以前一张图为底稿，先后修改服装、配饰和桌面物件，到后段仍能单独调整戒指、镜框等细节。Seed 称，这一版针对局部编辑做了专项训练，以减少未修改区域在反复生成中的偏色和细节流失。

The new version also improves the rendering of lighting, materials, skin textures, and dense small text, and is being successively launched on Jiemeng, Doubao, Doubao Work, and Huoshan Fangzhou. 新版也改善了光照、材质、皮肤纹理和密集小字的渲染，正陆续在即梦、豆包、豆包工作和火山方舟上线。

🔗 Related reading: Whose AI is so receptive to advice? Seedream 5.5 radically redesigns iPhone Duo interface, precise to the pixel level 🔗 相关阅读： 谁家 AI 这么听劝？Seedream 5.5 爆改 iPhone Duo 界面，精准到像素级

item.title: LG 免费开放 K-EXAONE 2.5 模型 API
item.guid: LG-免费开放-K-EXAONE-2.5-模型-API
item.description:
On November 9, LG AI Research opened K-EXAONE 2.5 on the EXAONE API Platform. Developers, startups, enterprises, and research institutions can apply for API keys to freely call the model for service development and research. LG AI 研究院 11 月 9 日在 EXAONE API Platform 开放 K-EXAONE 2.5。开发者、初创公司、企业及研究机构可以申请 API 密钥，免费调用模型，用于开发服务和研究。

K-EXAONE 2.5 is a technology verification model that has undergone additional training based on the version LG released in August this year, targeting tasks such as code writing, web retrieval, and workflow automation. LG announced self-test results based on public datasets, with SWE-Bench Pro, which evaluates real software development tasks, scoring 59.2, and BrowseComp, which evaluates web information retrieval, scoring 78.0. K-EXAONE 2.5 是在 LG 今年 8 月公布的版本上追加训练的技术验证模型，面向代码编写、网页检索和工作流自动化等任务。LG 公布了基于公开数据集的自测结果，其中评估真实软件开发任务的 SWE-Bench Pro 得分为 59.2，评估网页信息检索的 BrowseComp 得分为 78.0。

item.title: 百度披露 ERNIE Evolve，已用于优化文心 5.5 Flash 推理
item.guid: 百度披露-ERNIE-Evolve，已用于优化文心-5.5-Flash-推理
item.description:
Baidu Wenxin unveiled its automated research system, ERNIE Evolve, on November 9, and disclosed that it has used it to optimize the inference efficiency of Wenxin 5.5 Flash. The system proposes research directions based on historical experimental results, and then multiple agents divide tasks to select code starting points and modify code. Each round of changes must pass independent evaluation and review, and experimental code and results will be reserved for subsequent research. 百度文心 11 月 9 日公开了自动研究系统 ERNIE Evolve，并披露已用它优化文心 5.5 Flash 的推理效率。系统会根据历史实验结果提出研究方向，再由多个智能体分工选择代码起点、修改代码。每轮改动须通过独立评测和复核，实验代码和结果会留给后续研究使用。

Baidu listed three types of actual R&D tasks in its technical blog, including low-latency inference on Kunlunxin P800, deterministic inference throughput on GPUs, and single-concurrent decoding speed. In the P800 low-latency task, the team limited the scope of changes to chip adaptation plugins, keeping the model and deployment method unchanged. The system successively attempted operator fusion, speculative decoding, and scheduling and communication optimization. The optimal version achieved a generation speed of 623.6% of the initial baseline and passed the team's correctness checks. 百度在技术博客中列出了三类实际研发任务，包括昆仑芯 P800 上的低时延推理、GPU 上的确定性推理吞吐，以及单并发解码速度。在 P800 的低时延任务中，团队限定改动范围为芯片适配插件，保持模型和部署方式不变。系统先后尝试融合算子、投机解码以及调度和通信优化，最优版本的生成速度达到初始基线的 623.6%，并通过了团队的正确性检查。

Baidu stated that it plans to use this method for training system optimization, model capability research, and evaluation system iteration, and will continue to limit the system's permissions and resource scope. 百度称，接下来计划将这套方法用于训练系统优化、模型能力研究和评测体系迭代，并继续限制系统的权限和资源范围。

item.title: Meta 推出小模型 Muse Ember，专门处理 AI 助手的重复任务
item.guid: Meta-推出小模型-Muse-Ember，专门处理-AI-助手的重复任务
item.description:
Meta released the multimodal model Muse Ember, designed for tasks requiring repetitive execution, such as small steps in programming, tool calls, document summarization, and field extraction. It is Meta's first model trained using Muse Wonder Full, and has been launched on Muse Code and Meta Model API, supporting Responses API. Meta 发布多模态模型 Muse Ember，面向需要反复执行的任务，例如编程中的小步骤、工具调用、文档摘要和字段提取。它是 Meta 首个使用 Muse Wonder Full 训练的模型，已在 Muse Code 和 Meta Model API 上线，支持 Responses API。

Muse Ember supports a context of 1 million tokens. When prompts do not exceed 200,000 tokens, the API charges $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens. Muse Ember 支持 100 万 token 的上下文。提示不超过 20 万 token 时，API 每百万输入 token 收费 0.10 美元，每百万输出 token 收费 0.50 美元。

item.title: 门店贴出「买烟优先结账」，零食有鸣客服称会核实
item.guid: 门店贴出「买烟优先结账」，零食有鸣客服称会核实
item.description:
Recently, a notice posted at a snack store, Youming, stating 'Customers purchasing cigarettes have priority checkout,' sparked consumer doubts about queuing rules. On November 9, Youming customer service told Jiemian News that the company had not issued any document regarding this, and customer service would forward the lead to the relevant supervisory department for verification. 近日，一家零食有鸣门店贴出「购买香烟者优先结账」的告示，引发消费者对排队规则的质疑。11 月 9 日，零食有鸣客服向界面新闻表示，公司没有就此出台文件，客服会把线索转交相应监督部门核实。

Customer service also explained that stores selling cigarettes must first obtain a tobacco retail license, and the supply is purchased by the stores from local tobacco companies, with the brand headquarters not involved in procurement. For operational issues of franchised stores, the brand owner has the right to intervene in management. 客服还介绍，门店售卖卷烟须先取得烟草专卖零售许可证，货源由门店向当地烟草公司采购，品牌总部不参与进货。对于加盟门店的经营问题，品牌方有权介入管理。

item.title: 12 月起，进口小客车可在「交管 12123」网上办结上牌
item.guid: 12-月起，进口小客车可在「交管-12123」网上办结上牌
item.description:
The Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security announced that starting December 1, owners purchasing imported small passenger vehicles can complete new vehicle license plate selection and registration online via the 'Traffic Management 12123' App, without needing to visit a service window. Traffic management departments will integrate pre-inspection information for imported small passenger vehicles based on shared vehicle sales invoices, purchase tax, and insurance information. 公安部交通管理局宣布，自 12 月 1 日起，购买进口小客车的车主可通过「交管 12123」App 在线办结新车选号、登记上牌业务，无需前往窗口。交管部门将在共享车辆销售发票、购置税和保险信息的基础上，接入进口小客车预查验信息。

The same batch of measures also allows automobile manufacturers to apply for temporary license plates for test vehicles online. Companies can present their electronic business licenses to handle new car registration, used car transfers, and other services, and can register online via the App to inquire about the status of vehicles under the company's name and information on violations and accidents. 同批措施还允许汽车生产企业网上申领试验车临时号牌。企业出示电子营业执照，即可办理新车上牌、二手车过户等业务，并可通过 App 网上注册，查询企业名下车辆状态及违法事故信息。

Municipalities directly under the central government, provincial capitals, capitals of autonomous regions, and cities with separate planning status will pilot the App's intelligent customer service 'Jiaoguan Xiaoan,' supporting simultaneous consultation and business processing. 直辖市、省会城市、自治区首府及计划单列市将试点 App 智能客服「交管小安」，支持边咨询边办理业务。

item.title: Netflix 推进《卡坦岛》真人电影，据报将由尼兄弟编剧执导
item.guid: Netflix-推进《卡坦岛》真人电影，据报将由尼兄弟编剧执导
item.description:
According to Deadline, Aaron Nee and Adam Nee, who directed 'The Lost City,' will write and direct a live-action film adaptation of 'Catan' for Netflix. This is the first live-action film project to disclose its main creative team since Netflix acquired the global adaptation rights for the board game last year. 据 Deadline 报道，曾执导《迷失之城》的亚伦·尼和亚当·尼将为 Netflix 编剧并执导《卡坦岛》真人电影。这是 Netflix 去年拿下这款桌游的全球改编权后，首个披露主创阵容的真人电影项目。

'Catan' was created by German board game designer Klaus Teuber, where players compete for limited resources, form alliances, trade, and build settlements on an island. Netflix previously announced a partnership with board game publisher Asmodee to develop live-action, animated, and non-fiction content based on 'Catan'. 《卡坦岛》由德国桌游设计师克劳斯·托伊伯创作，玩家在岛上争取有限资源、结盟交易并建设定居点。Netflix 此前宣布与桌游发行商 Asmodee 合作，开发以《卡坦岛》为基础的真人、动画和非虚构内容。

item.title: 郑雨盛主演武打片《杀生簿》国际销售权由 Finecut 拿下
item.guid: 郑雨盛主演武打片《杀生簿》国际销售权由-Finecut-拿下
item.description:
According to Deadline and Variety, Korean film sales company Finecut has acquired the international sales rights for the action film 'The Hit List' (杀生簿). The film, directed by Kim Hong-sun, who also directed 'Project Wolf Hunting' and the third season of 'Gangs of London,' began filming in October this year. 据 Deadline 和 Variety 报道，韩国电影销售公司 Finecut 拿下武打片《杀生簿》（The Hit List）的国际销售权。影片由执导过《狼狩猎》和《伦敦黑帮》第三季的金泓善执导，已于今年 10 月开拍。

The film is adapted from a webtoon on the Kakao platform with over 120 million views. Set in the Joseon Dynasty, Jung Woo-sung, actor from '12.12: The Day,' plays the powerful minister Han Myeong-hoe, and Wi Ha-joon, actor from 'Squid Game,' plays Grand Prince Suyang, who uses Han Myeong-hoe's power to usurp the throne from his young nephew. 影片改编自 Kakao 平台一部浏览量超过 1.2 亿次的网漫。故事发生在朝鲜王朝，《首尔之春》演员郑雨盛饰演权臣韩明浍，《鱿鱼游戏》演员魏嘏隽饰演首阳大君，后者借韩明浍之力争夺年幼侄子的王位。

Russ Cox, the cinematographer for the third season of 'Gangs of London,' and gaffer Kieran Waite have also joined this film. 《伦敦黑帮》第三季的摄影指导拉斯·考克斯和灯光师基兰·韦茨也加入了本片。
